target: Public inspiration index and product credit articles

references: Existing study index and evidence dossier

contract.purpose: Publicly credit the tools and projects that shaped PostTrainLLM and let readers follow each influence from original source to local evidence and limits.
contract.purposeSource: PRODUCT.md, DESIGN.md, GitHub Issue #172 and owner scope/design selections
contract.canonicalPurpose: PostTrainLLM turns learning into inspectable local artifacts and bounded specialist objectives into evidence-gated Mac-local factory runs.
contract.audience: Learners and practitioners exploring Mac-local model training and evaluation who want to see which outside projects informed the lab.
contract.job: Make the acknowledgments easy to browse and give each project a source-linked article that separates admiration, adoption, local evidence, and boundary.
contract.thesis: A large editorial thank-you opens into a numbered index and calm, source-traced articles, extending the established dark research bench.
contract.system: Deep ink canvas, teal links and evidence labels, Bricolage display headlines, Geist prose, Geist Mono source identities, hairline dividers, generous spacing, and one-column mobile reflow.
contract.signature: A numbered wall of named projects pairs public thanks with exact local evidence and a boundary section on every article.
contract.risk: An appreciative tone could imply adoption or endorsement; each article names the local disposition and links the original project plus our evidence.

projectCheck.command: pnpm --dir browser exec vitest run src/__tests__/inspirations.test.ts && pnpm --dir browser build

findings: The primary index is intentionally long; source trails live in the individual articles, while the existing studies index remains the denser evidence view.

ownerFeedback.note: The owner explicitly selected A, the acknowledgment wall, after viewing all three rendered previews in the conversation.
